rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for enveloping someone or something in a protective covering.

example.english: I cocoon the hot-water bottle in a towel so it stays warm longer.
example.traditional: 我用毛巾包住個暖水袋，等佢冇咁快凍。
